title: OpenContext Configuration
description: Configuration schema for OpenContext MCP server.

$schema.description: URL to the OpenContext JSON schema.

path.description: Custom directory path for storing context markdown files.

disabled.description: Temporarily disables OpenContext tools without removing the MCP server.

autoIndex.description: Automatically generates and maintains index.md for token savings.

history.description: Configuration for context file history and backups.

enabled.description: Whether to enable context file history tracking.

maxBackupsPerTopic.description: Maximum number of backup files to keep per topic.

retentionDays.description: Number of days to retain backup files before cleanup.

guard.description: Configuration for the write guard and validation system.

enabled.description: Whether the write guard is enabled.

maxFileSizeKb.description: Maximum allowed payload size in kilobytes.

strictPatternCheck.description: Whether to check for forbidden prompt injection patterns.
